faqs.question: What is included in full home deep cleaning?
faqs.answer: Deep cleaning covers complete kitchen degreasing, bathroom scrubbing & descaling, balcony washing, floor scrubbing, door/window track vacuuming, and fan/switchboard wipe-down.

faqs.question: Which areas in Pune do you provide cleaning services?
faqs.answer: We cover all areas in Pune and PCMC including Baner, Wakad, Hinjewadi, Kharadi, Viman Nagar, Kothrud, Hadapsar, and Aundh.

faqs.question: Do you bring your own machines and chemicals?
faqs.answer: Yes, our 100% in-house team arrives equipped with industrial vacuum cleaners, single-disc scrubbers, and certified eco-friendly chemicals.
